rule: Specification of the candidate coset multiplication

conditions.condition: The inputs are left cosets aN and bN in G/N.
conditions.justification: The preceding node identifies the elements of G/N as left cosets.

conditions.condition: For a,b in G, the product ab is an element of G and therefore determines a left coset abN.
conditions.justification: Closure in G gives ab in G, and N being a subgroup makes abN a coset represented in G/N.

circularity.justification: This line specifies the candidate product formula; it does not yet invoke the later conclusion that the formula is well-defined.

conclusion.justification: The displayed equation coherently specifies the intended product on coset representatives; independence of representatives remains a separate well-definedness obligation.

reason: As a formula proposing the quotient multiplication, the line is valid; it should not itself be read as having already proved well-definedness.
